entries.name: Incident Post-Mortem
entries.body: All P0/P1 incidents require blameless post-mortem within 7 days. Findings are public.

entries.name: API Rate Governance
entries.body: Per-provider rate limits are governed by capability declaration, not commercial agreement.

entries.name: Telemetry Privacy
entries.body: System telemetry is anonymized before aggregation. No PII in telemetry streams.

entries.name: Open Source Commitment
entries.body: Core routing engine and constitutional enforcement code are open source under Apache 2.0.

entries.name: Community Contribution
entries.body: External contributions follow standard PR review. Constitutional changes require Council approval.

entries.name: Training Data Provenance
entries.body: AI providers must declare training data provenance for models used in routing.
